clue.text: Pass very large southern American figure of epic size

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
OS stands for outsize, a clothing size
US, the United States, stands for American

explanation.surface: A towering southern American figure who once crossed a mountain pass, described in epic terms.
explanation.walkthrough: OS (outsize) is a garment label for very large sizes.
explanation.definitionFit: A giant statue or person of enormous stature, like the one at Rhodes, is a figure of epic proportions.

clue.text: On strike about railway, getting public disapproval

parts.note: workers out are on strike
C, for circa, means about

explanation.surface: Rail workers walking out provoke anger from the public.
explanation.definitionFit: A loud general protest is public disapproval, a synonym.

clue.text: In Dover, terminal is in the open

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the words Dover terminal

explanation.surface: At the Dover ferry terminal, things are out in the open air.
explanation.walkthrough: Dover is the English Channel port.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done openly and not concealed is in the open, so the adjective fits.

clue.text: Mark left in some coin that's reproduced

indicators.note: the letter for left goes inside the rearranged letters
copied in a new form, so the letters of some coin are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mark on the left side of a counterfeit coin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reproduced' rearranges SOMECOIN to SEMICOON, and 'in' puts L inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A punctuation sign, the dot over a comma, is a kind of mark.

clue.text: Note liberal expression of annoyance upset young celebrity

indicators.note: in a down entry upset turns the whole run upside down, reading it backwards

parts.note: te is a note of the sol-fa scale
rats is an exclamation of annoyance

explanation.surface: An annoyed exclamation from a liberal upsets a young star.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' reverses TE L RATS as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: A young actress tipped for stardom is a young celebrity.

clue.text: Heading west, shooter needs to grab some gold

indicators.note: in an across entry westward is right to left, so the word for the shooter is read backwards

parts.note: a gun is a shooter
to get is to grab or obtain

explanation.surface: A gunslinger riding west in the gold rush needs to stake a claim.
explanation.definitionFit: A lump of the precious metal found in the ground is a small quantity of it, so it is some gold.

clue.text: Nick books put in Northern church

indicators.note: the books are placed inside the other two pieces

parts.note: OT, the Old Testament, is a set of books

explanation.surface: Someone steals books and puts them in a northern church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nick' looks like 'steal' but means a small cut.
explanation.definitionFit: A small V-shaped cut is a nick, a synonym.

clue.text: Follow retired fellow with dodgy heart, criminal mastermind

indicators.note: retired means drawn back, so the word for follow is read upwards

parts.note: to dog someone is to follow them

indicators.note: dodgy means unsound, so the letters of heart are rearranged

explanation.surface: Tracking a retired man with a weak heart who runs a crime syndicate.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a Mafia family, as in the famous film, is a criminal mastermind.

clue.text: Request Eastern feast in US city

indicators.note: the feast goes inside the city's abbreviation

parts.note: NY is New York
a treat is a feast or special pleasure

explanation.surface: Someone asks for an oriental banquet in an American city.
explanation.definitionFit: An earnest plea or appeal is a request, a synonym.

clue.text: Current group of pupils

definitions.meaning: a flow of water, as in a brook or a current of air
a class set by ability in a school year

explanation.surface: Something about the latest group of schoolchildren.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a flowing body of water and an ability set of schoolchildren share this word.

clue.text: A comment found about largely neat remedy

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the word for a comment goes around the shortened word for neat

parts.note: a note is a brief comment

indicators.note: largely means most of the word, so its last letter is dropped

parts.note: tidy means neat

explanation.surface: Someone finds a remark about a fairly tidy cure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neat' here means orderly, not undiluted as a drink; 'largely' drops its final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A cure or counter to a poison is a remedy, a synonym.

clue.text: Poor clot that's violated etiquette

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are broken up and rearranged, as rules are when violated

explanation.surface: A poor idiot has breached the rules of good manners.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal rules of diplomatic or official conduct are a kind of etiquette, a synonym.

clue.text: Footballing action in item at top of page

definitions.meaning: striking the ball with the head in football
text printed in the top margin of a page, above the main body

explanation.surface: A newspaper item at the top of the sports page about a goal scored with the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a football shot with the head and the running text at the top of a printed page take this name.

clue.text: Show command as a decisive photographer does?

definitions.meaning: to be in charge and make the decisions
a photographer who decides which pictures to take literally chooses which shots to take

explanation.surface: A photographer confidently showing who is in charge of the session.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to be the one making decisions, i.e. displaying authority; the photographer reading is a literal pun.

clue.text: Sparkling wine left by trainee short of time in procession

parts.note: cava is a Spanish sparkling wine

indicators.note: short of means lacking, so the letter for time is dropped

parts.note: a cadet is a trainee officer

explanation.surface: A trainee runs out of time leaving fizz behind in a parade.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal parade of horses or vehicles is a procession, a synonym.

clue.text: Menu motel devised for profit

indicators.note: devised means worked out anew, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A motel owner plans a menu to make money.
explanation.definitionFit: Pay or earnings from employment are a gain, so profit fits as a synonym.

clue.text: Leave friend with cold on reflection? That's nonsense

indicators.note: a reflection is mirrored, so the whole run of pieces is reversed

parts.note: to part is to leave
a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: Someone deciding, on reflection, that leaving a friend who has a cold is silly talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Empty, pretentious talk is nonsense, a synonym.

clue.text: At the last minute before midnight?

definitions.text: At the last minute before midnight?

parts.words: At the last minute before midnight?
parts.note: the idiom for 'very late, almost too late' is also, literally, the hour from eleven to midnight, which contains the final minute before twelve

explanation.surface: Something done in the final minute before the clock strikes twelve.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means at the last possible moment; literally it is the period from eleven o'clock to twelve.

clue.text: Save partner in match

definitions.meaning: to use sparingly or conserve resources
a match here is a marriage, and the man is one partner in it

explanation.surface: Keeping one's partner in a game safe.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to conserve thriftily; the noun is a married man, a spouse in a marriage.

clue.text: Face pressure entering a schismatic religious group

indicators.note: the pressure letter goes into the word for the group

parts.note: a sect is a group broken away from a larger religion
P is the symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Facing pressure on joining a breakaway religious group.
explanation.definitionFit: One side or facet of something is an aspect, as in each face of a problem.

clue.text: Revered figure, a Spanish chicken?

parts.note: pollo is the Spanish word for chicken

explanation.surface: A whimsical question whether a revered idol is merely a Spanish hen.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of the sun and music is a revered deity, so a god fits a revered figure.

clue.text: Revealed note that's rather shocking

parts.note: a secret that is out has been revealed
re is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A message is revealed that is rather shocking.
explanation.definitionFit: Unconventional to the point of being startling or improper, the borrowed French adjective means somewhat shocking.

clue.text: Good soldier stuck in liquid mud, slow-moving

indicators.note: the good soldier is stuck inside the muddy word, i.e. placed within it

parts.note: slush is wet, half-liquid mud or snow
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A worthy soldier bogged down in the mud can only move slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: Lethargic and sluggard-like, the word describes something slow and inactive in movement.

clue.text: Manage board

definitions.meaning: to climb aboard a bus or train

explanation.surface: Run a committee.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means to cope or fare and also to climb aboard a vehicle.

clue.text: Best support, we're told, for calorific meal

parts.note: the cream is the best part, as in the cream of the crop

indicators.note: signals that the word for support is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: a tee is the peg supporting a golf ball

explanation.surface: The finest backing, apparently, for a fattening repast.
explanation.walkthrough: A cream tea is a British afternoon meal of scones with clotted cream and jam, plus a pot of tea.
explanation.definitionFit: Scones loaded with clotted cream and jam make a rich, high-energy afternoon spread, so a calorific meal.

clue.text: Course in French service, perhaps

parts.note: en is French for in
the service tree is a kind of tree related to rowan, so service is an example

explanation.surface: A dish served in French table service, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' looks like waiting at table but is the service tree, a European woodland tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A dish served as one part of a meal, typically the main dish, is a course.

clue.text: Circle note at end of letter to return present

indicators.note: the postscript abbreviation goes back, so is read in reverse

parts.note: PS, a postscript, is a note added at the end of a letter
here means present, as in a roll call

explanation.surface: A postscript asking someone to send back a gift encircled in the letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A sphere is one's field of influence or social set, as in a circle of friends or one's sphere.

clue.text: Set off to make school in time

indicators.note: the school is placed within the word for time

parts.note: a date is a point in time
Eton is the famous English public school

explanation.surface: Someone leaving just in time to get to school.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton College is an elite English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: To set off a bomb or charge is to make it explode.
